hot_path.name: RunResidentRows
hot_path.source_reads: x and residual are consumed once per row
hot_path.resident_value: FP32 u=x+residual remains in one UB row
hot_path.precision: FP32 RMS; norm=u/rms*gamma cast to native THEN +bias in native (golden: output=norm+bias)

generic_path.name: RunGenericRows
generic_path.coverage: FP16/BF16/FP32 and all legal rows and D
generic_path.precision: same NormPlusBias chain as hot path

v005_changes.formula: output = T(T(u / rms * gamma) + bias) with rms = sqrt(mean(u*u)+eps)
